en.summary: In this narration from *Nahj al-Balagha*, a man approaches Imam Ali (peace be upon him) during the turbulent period of the Battle of the Camel to inquire about the nature of the *fitnah* (trial) and whether the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) had previously addressed it. This highlights the Shia belief in the continuity of prophetic knowledge (*ilm*) transferred to the Imams, positioning Ali as the authoritative interpreter of events foreseen by the Prophet. The inquiry underscores the urgency of understanding divine signs amidst the political strife in Basra.
en.seo_question: What did the man ask Imam Ali about regarding the Prophet's knowledge of fitnah?

Pertanyaan tersebut menekankan urgensi memahami tanda-tanda ilahi di tengah perselisihan politik di Bashrah.
